title: Rockman EXE 4.5 - Real Operation
sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 567 (translation hash linked; addresses converted to GBA bus addresses)

widgets.text:
You play as the PET operator; pick a Navi partner for each battle
HP, Battle Chips; Navi has its own personality and AI

Many Navis from the series can be partnered
Each Navi has its own Navi Chips and stats
Choose chips; the Navi acts on its own between your inputs

rows: the battle runs in real time

widgets.text:
ACDC Town and the Net areas
Real-time clock events (date and time) change what happens in the game

Story events and tournaments
Unique chips found are counted (see Collection)
English translation in the Translations folder; version 1.1 (from the file name)
